summary: This theme consolidates research on attitudes, perceptions, and emotional responses of learners and teachers toward generative AI and LLMs in language education, including trust, confidence, motivation, and concerns like over-reliance or ethical issues.
This theme focuses on how students perceive and emotionally respond to feedback from AI compared to human instructors, including trade-offs in immediacy, personalization, and psychological impacts.

This theme highlights the positive impact of generative AI tools on learners' confidence, motivation, and self-efficacy in language tasks, particularly writing, through personalized and interactive support.
This theme explores how AI tools enhance learner engagement, motivation, and emotional outcomes in language education, including factors like enjoyment, anxiety, and willingness to communicate.
This theme examines how generative AI and LLMs empower learners to take control of their language learning through self-directed, personalized, and strategic engagement.
This theme represents undefined or missing research areas in the intersection of generative AI and language education, highlighting opportunities for future investigation.
